description: This file defines the MyAttendanceRecordAPI class, which extends EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI and provides API endpoints related to employee attendance records, including parsing punch-in/punch-out times, validation, and user permissions for attendance actions within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: API class handling employee attendance record operations, including validation, time extraction, and permission checks, within the OrangeHRM attendance module.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules for fetching attendance records, removing employee number validation for the current context.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Converts a string datetime into a DateTime object with timezone considerations and validates whether the date-time is acceptable based on system configuration.

methods.name: isCurrantDateTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided user datetime is within an acceptable +/- 180 second window of the system’s current time.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchInActions
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to perform punch-in actions based on allowed actions array.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchOutActions
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to perform punch-out actions based on allowed actions array.
